limitations: This evidence applies to the recorded bridge hash; changed source requires appropriate reruns.
Native processor completion is not independent physical inspection.

Typed restore excludes unsupported fields, physical state and calibration evidence; it preserves newer consumption and added identities.
The finite zero-pitch virtual native tray fixture is distinct from default strip feeder qualification.
The 10000-record document round trip executes no placements and is not a 10000-placement or eight-hour qualification.
